question: Fed cuts rates by 25+ bps at the September 2026 meeting?
description: This market will resolve to Yes if the Federal Open Market Committee lowers its target federal funds rate by 25 basis points or more at its September 2026 meeting. Resolution is based on the FOMC statement published on federalreserve.gov.

question: Will the S&P 500 close above 7500 on December 31, 2026?
description: This market will resolve to Yes if the official closing level of the S&P 500 index on December 31, 2026 is above 7500, per S&P Dow Jones Indices.

question: Bitcoin above $150,000 on December 31, 2026?
description: This market will resolve to Yes if the price of Bitcoin is above $150,000 at 5pm ET on December 31, 2026, according to the Coinbase BTC-USD spot price.

question: Will Brazil win the 2026 FIFA World Cup?
description: This market will resolve to Yes if Brazil wins the 2026 FIFA World Cup, according to the official FIFA result of the final.

question: Will the US avoid a recession in 2026?
description: This market will resolve to Yes if the NBER Business Cycle Dating Committee does not declare a recession with a peak occurring in 2026.

question: Will Arsenal win the 2026-27 Premier League?
description: This market will resolve to Yes if Arsenal finish first in the 2026-27 Premier League season.
